summary: Unexpected region-priority flip and transient LB reweight caused inference p99 jitter and sporadic 504s for dedicated customer
description: Issue summary: Beginning 2026-03-12 06:20 UTC a subset of requests for Foliage Labs' dedicated pool started to experience elevated p50/p95/p99 latency and occasional 504 timeouts. Impact: customer reports degraded UX for streaming chat and model completions; some requests aborted mid-stream. Scope: only Foliage Labs' dedicated pool in us-east showed persistent errors with spillover to us-west when routing attempted failover. Initial indicators show a short-lived region priority change in the control plane followed by on-path load-balancer reweights. This ticket tracks triage, mitigation, and root-cause for the event.
impact: ~4% of requests returned 504 or aborted streaming; p99 for completion API increased from ~180ms to ~2.1s for the affected pool; customer reported user-facing session errors and elevated error rates in their application. No billing discrepancies reported.
timeline: 2026-03-12 06:19 UTC - Foliage Labs alerted Support via in-app chat: ‘spikes in latency and streaming disconnects’
2026-03-12 06:21 UTC - Automated alert: route-p99 > 1s for dedicated/us-east pool in RB-42 cluster
2026-03-12 06:25 UTC - Support opened ticket and engaged SRE; created INC-20260312-07
2026-03-12 06:28 UTC - Control-plane health event shows region priority flip: us-west briefly became preferred for requests to this pool
2026-03-12 06:30 UTC - LB reweight job executed (auto-rebalance) and several nodes in us-east were moved to lower weight while warm-up completed in us-west
2026-03-12 06:40 UTC - Short-term mitigation applied: pinned routing policy to prefer us-east for Foliage Labs; error rates dropped but p99 remained elevated until 07:10 UTC
2026-03-12 07:12 UTC - Full rollback of reweighting completed; post-rollback p99 returned to baseline by 07:35 UTC
steps_to_reproduce: 1) Use Foliage Labs' API key scoped to dedicated pool RB-42 in us-east
2) Issue high-concurrency streaming requests with average 512 token output using model redwood-open-7B
3) Observe increased TTFB and occasional 504s during the window when control-plane region priority flips are exercised
4) Note that reproducing requires triggering the routing reweight (internal control-plane action) or simulated reweight in staging

investigation_notes: Hypothesis 1: Control-plane region priority detection triggered an unnecessary failover due to a transient healthcheck flapping in one us-east node group.
Hypothesis 2: Load-balancer automatic reweighting performed an aggressive instant weight change without connection draining, causing packet drops and TCP retransmits.
Checked: no deploys to RB-42 at the incident time; no config changes from customer side.
Observed: nodes in us-east showed elevated TCP retransmit and socket backlog metrics coincident with reweight event. Kernel-level socket stats indicate increased ESTABLISHED->CLOSE-WAIT transitions.
Next: Collect full tcpdump from de-weighted nodes, add smoothing to reweight job, and add a pre-check in control-plane to avoid flipping priority when only transient healthcheck anomalies present.
workaround: Pinned routing policy for Foliage Labs' pool RB-42 to us-east until we validate and apply safer reweighting logic. Instructed customer to add exponential backoff on client retries for streaming failures.
action_items: SRE: Capture tcpdump and socket stats from affected nodes and attach to incident (assigned: Liam)
Infra: Implement draining window for LB reweight jobs (assigned: Jonah)
Control-plane: Add hysteresis to region-priority evaluation logic to ignore single healthcheck misses (assigned: Priya)
Observability: Create dashboard that highlights in-flight connection counts during reweight operations (assigned: Erin)
Postmortem: Draft within 7 days and link to this ticket (owner: Product Ops)
notes: This incident impacted a single dedicated customer pool and exposed a weakness in the LB reweight/drain behavior. No broad customer impact observed. Will follow up with a postmortem and code changes to reweight job.
